name: threadlight-skills
description: Threadlight pilot pipeline — 23 pipeline skills + threadlight-auto agent-guided lifecycle planner (24 total) that take a customer engagement from brief to a working pilot with selected runtime governance and an evidence-backed path to production. Includes threadlight-qualify (no-repo/Cowork declared sizing, no Azure), threadlight-design, threadlight-local-test, threadlight-deploy, threadlight-safe-check, threadlight-demo-data-factory, threadlight-event-triggers, threadlight-hitl-patterns, threadlight-workspace-ui, threadlight-consumption-iq (forecast, settled actuals, reconciliation and measured cost per successful interaction), threadlight-evals, threadlight-redteam, threadlight-govern (native ACS/Rego bundle authoring and real selected host/service generation), threadlight-governed-actions (runtime templates, executed local action-path proof, approval/audit and change-plane evidence), threadlight-agentops (optional per-agent bound operational evidence; not another evaluation or governance engine), threadlight-production-ready (advisory review; explicit strict CI gate), threadlight-connect (manual contract/OBO-evidenced mock-to-real swap), threadlight-ground (manual ACL/citation/refusal evidence), threadlight-loadtest (manual budget-capped live evidence), threadlight-upgrade (plan-only compatibility), threadlight-cicd (OIDC/WIF customer pipeline handoff), threadlight-customize (fork and customer onboarding), and threadlight-router-bench (offline finished-run learning). Auto plans; the coding agent executes; manual/live/cost-bearing legs remain explicit handoffs. SAFE is the method, ACS the PDP, Agent Hooks the host/interceptor contract, native host/gateway the PEP, AGT the toolkit and ASSERT assurance. Policy, CI and local native/CTK evidence never imply whole-agent governance; the registered noop collector cannot certify business bindings. Preview/alpha boundaries and current v1 migration are documented. Supports Kratos-export enrichment without replacing its runtime. Also bundles an optional GitHub Copilot App Lifecycle Canvas. USE FOR: pilot pipeline, sizing, design, local test, deploy, safe-check, selected runtime governance, signed policy, Agent Hooks, fail-closed actions, authenticated one-use human approval, central audit ACK, AgentOps evidence, production readiness, cost evidence, CI/CD and customer onboarding. DO NOT USE FOR: central Citadel hub deployment (use citadel-hub-deploy) or generic Foundry reference (use awesome-gbb).
